narrative: vLLM v0.24.0's quantized-by-default Model Runner V2 and its multi-tier KV-cache offloading that spills cache to an object-store tier beyond GPU memory are exactly the serving-layer preconditions for single-node deployment: low-precision weights plus a smaller GPU memory floor turn a heavy open-weight checkpoint from a cluster job into a single high-memory node.
remaining_gap: No specific 700B-plus model shown fitting under 256GB on one node with independently reproduced accuracy retention; this enables the prediction rather than fulfilling it.
